mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and job growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market conditions, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and PAYEMS is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 60d SPX returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for residential construction, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5d SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and unemployment is low (UNRATE < 4.0%), the combination signals an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression of 60d SPX returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 115.0), the manufacturing sector is expanding, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
